# Vendored: Lua

This directory is an unmodified copy of the PUC-Rio Lua 5.4.9 release.

- Upstream: https://www.lua.org/ftp/lua-5.4.9.tar.gz
- SHA-256: 2335b6c582a52654f94612bf10d2f4672805d05329aa6568b1d8cd9e5c6fb8e6
- License: MIT (see the notice at the end of `src/lua.h` and in
  `doc/readme.html`)

To update, replace the contents of this directory (except this file) with
the contents of the desired release tarball, check its SHA-256 against
the one lua.org lists, and update the references above.
